notes: Root is large, rounded, and textured with overlapping scale-like markings; leaves alternate green and ochre in coloring along branched stem; single bud/flower at apex; minor staining at page edges.
Upper scene: large funnel/canopy structure in blue suspends over a green fluid column with embedded figures; lower-right cluster shows grouped figures in green rounded enclosure. Page numbered 75.
Two tiles: left tile has elongated recumbent animal at centre; right tile has standing quadruped at centre. Small stain visible on right tile mid-left.

Three tall ornate tiered vessels run along left margin; plant fragments arranged in ~3 horizontal rows; bottom row includes a wavy undulating stem form; one fragment shows dotted/spotted surface texture.
Two small red forked/branched forms at left margin; large pale green lobed shapes embedded mid-text; lower page shows staining and edge damage.
Large pale blue-green wash circle behind plant body. Stems red-lined. Three spiky globose flowerheads with small red dots at calyx bases. Root curls ornately.

Dominant feature is one very large, round, green-painted leaf on a single upright stem. Smaller lobed leaves and an uncolored flower visible at apex. Faint radiating strokes visible behind large leaf, possibly offset or underdrawing. Root zone shows small fibrous/stringy elements at page base.
Large bleed/offset of green pigment on left; leaves banded red and green with dotted margins and pointed tips; one broad basal leaf distinct.

Primary plant has elongated curved root/rhizome in brown with ring-like nodes. Large rounded blue flower head with pale ochre secondary head. Faint second plant visible left (ghost/offset). Lobed leaves have pointed tips/spines.
Heavy blue-grey staining lower-left; offset marks from facing folio visible. Leaves painted bicolor green/red. Small closed buds at branch tips, uncolored.

Bulbous root with splayed appendages; multiple star-burst whorls of narrow green leaves along stem; large blue bell-shaped terminal flower. Faint offset/transfer of leaf shapes visible in centre-left area.
Large palmate/lobed leaves radiate from central stem; small bud-like flower at apex with blue cap; root zone shows small bulbous/tuberous forms; green pigment offset visible in lower page margin.
Large pale-green wash bleed/stain behind plant; flowers show red tubular petals with small blue centre dots; root is compact tuberous with trailing filaments.
Bulbous node at stem base above fibrous roots. Leaves very broad, deeply toothed/spiky margins. Buds/flowers closed, ovoid, with red-rimmed aperture. Faint green offset impression visible mid-page.
Significant green pigment offset/staining visible on left margin. Flower heads are spiny/globose with blue centres and green spiny bracts. Leaf whorls star-shaped.
Single whorl of long narrow green leaves radiates from top of stem; central flower-like structure with white/uncolored petals bearing faint red midribs. Two-pronged branched root in ochre/brown.
Large green offset/bleed behind upper plant visible; basal leaves whorled/rosette; upper stem bears elongated red pod-like structures with dark dots; leaf edges fringed.
Dominant feature is one large lobed leaf, deeply sinuate with pointed tips, coloured green. A second smaller leaf visible mid-stem. Root system is ochre, spreading and irregular.
Three small tubular flowers at stem tips; petals appear bicolored red/blue with open calyx. Pale blue-green triangular wash behind upper stem. Root splays laterally in flat branched form.
Central taproot with fibrous lateral hairs; red branched stems spread widely; two tall flower spikes with small red beaded/dotted inflorescences; blue-green offset visible at lower left.
Large blue-green stain lower-left may affect colour reads. Some flowers show mixed blue/yellow pigment; petals broadly rounded, 4-5 visible per bloom.
Large blue-ink offset/bleed visible behind main plant. Two reddish ovoid root lobes at base. Flower head has radiating petals with ochre centre at upper right.

Heavy ink offset/ghost image visible behind plant. Leaves appear to spiral/twist around stem. Two pendant bell-shaped flowers on long arching pedicels. Root splays into fibrous branches with ochre wash. Possible foxing lower left.
Large domed canopy of densely overlapping scalloped leaves with blue flowers at margins; multiple pale tubular stems rise from fibrous ochre root mass; large paint offset stain upper left.
Large ovoid head of tightly overlapping scale-like leaves in green/ochre-brown. Multiple stems converge to branched red-tinted root with small lobed bulbous knobs. Blue tuft at apex. Stain mid-left.

Root is large, rounded-bulbous with red pigment, fibrous tendrils at base; small round buds clustered at apex with blue and white coloring; leaves large, lobed, green with ochre/brown overpaint patches.
Two stems share one root mass. Left stem bears blue, bulbous flowers with curved tines; leaves whorled in tiered, rounded clusters. Small red mark at top margin.
Root zone replaced by a coiled, banded zoomorphic form (serpentine). Offset ghost image of plant visible left. Bulbous seed-head with blue pigment below flower. Possible tear at right edge.
Two main upright stems share a stout tuberous root with blunt terminations. Flower heads are rounded, globose, and scalloped with small blue dot accents. Some water staining lower-left.
Sun-like radiate motif at apex of main stem. Small bulb/pod shapes hang from leaf margins. Green stain visible mid-left. Partial plant visible at right page edge.

Flower atop single tall stem has ochre/yellow lobed/wavy fringe at apex; large oval green leaves in rosette-like cluster; one leaf has dark oval marking; fibrous roots spread outward; faint green offset/bleed in lower left.
Root is broad, multi-lobed tuberous mass with small surface bristles; upper stem branches into multiple flowering spikes with small red and white florets amid narrow green bracts.
Large blue fringed flower at apex; 4 smaller red spiky radial flower heads with white centres on branched stems; bulbous ochre base; green offset visible lower left.
Three composite-like flower heads in dark blue with pale outer florets; faint offset ghost of large leaf shape visible upper-left; some foxing/staining near root zone.
Root is horizontal, fibrous/hairy with ochre wash. Upper stem branches into tendrils bearing dense clusters of small round red berry-like forms. Minor brown staining lower left.
Terminal flower has radiating blue petals with red circular center; a smaller budding flower mid-stem; faint green offset shapes in background.
Root zone rendered as elongated animal form in ochre; flower head circular with radiating fringe and small red markings at centre. Light green wash staining visible at left margin.

Large pinnately-lobed basal leaves with serrated margins; single terminal blue flower with ochre-edged petals; multiple smaller blue bud-like structures along branching upper stem. Significant blue-green pigment offset/stain left of plant. A faint pinkish vessel shape lower-left appears to be bleed-through or stain, not a drawn container.
Offset impression of another plant visible on left half of page. Root is bulbous-based with splayed red-brown extensions. Two small blue bell-like flowers at stem tips.
Blue offset/smearing visible on lower page. Small blue buds at stem tips; red oval marks on leaflets may be berries/seeds rather than flowers. Partial green plant visible at left page edge.
Multiple tall branched stems rise from a bulbous root; flowers have spiky bracts with prominent blue petals/lobes; narrow linear leaves in whorled clusters at nodes.

Multiple radiating branched stems with dense small opposite leaves; small ochre bead-like structures along stems suggest flower buds. Blue wash offset visible in text zone. Partial plant visible at left margin.
Green pigment offset/bleed visible left of stem. Root partially cropped at bottom. Flowers show blue petals with red pointed inner elements. Compound leaves have serrated leaflets.
Upper canopy bears catkin-like red beaded structures with 2–3 dark blue rounded forms at apex; large green lobed leaves mid-stem; green wash stain on left margin.

Root zone shows spiny/thorned horizontal runner with ring-link connectors in red/brown; bulbous base transitions to striated single stem. Large blue-green offset patch lower-left may be bleed-through.
Three plants share a single horizontal tuberous root-bar with scroll ends and pendant rootlets. Two plants bear blue clustered flowers with white centers; leaves distinctly palmate/lobed throughout.

Large central plant flanked by two smaller lateral plants; reddish branched roots spread wide; flowers show radiating petals with central disc; faint offset/ghost impression visible in lower-left background.
Two daisy-like flowers with radiating petals atop branched stems; large green blot stain lower-left may affect color readings; roots uncolored/stringy.
Leaves are rounded/lobed with a small pointed extension; white globular calyx-like structures subtend blue petal clusters. Pale green offset stain visible left of plant.
Large blue-green wash stain across left portion of page; small red marks at leaf nodes may suggest buds or stipules; root splays into several lateral branches.
Small zoomorphic figure (animal-like, uncolored) drawn beside the root base; light blue wash stain visible on left mid-page; leaves radiate broadly from central point.
Root is a compact bulbous node from which multiple red stems emerge; terminal blue berry-like clusters may be fruit rather than flowers. Green wash staining visible in background.
Root system is sinuous/looping with red pigment. Flowerheads are rounded, bicolored blue/white, atop thin stalks. Blue wash visible on central stem area. Possible light staining mid-left leaf.

Primary plant has large broad basal leaves; secondary smaller plant lower-right has rounded lobed leaves and fibrous root. Green offset staining visible mid-left. Flowers atop primary stem appear dark blue/tubular.
Large blue-green wash background. Flowers show radiating linear petals with red central dot; small blue teardrop accents at petal bases. Root is lobed/bulbous with small projecting nodules.

Primary plant: single erect stem, large lobed leaves, segmented spike/spadix-like structures with small red tip. Root is bulbous with curling tendrils, strongly zoomorphic. Secondary plant (left) is faint green, branched, with fibrous roots. Worm-hole damage lower-left.

Left plant heavily faded/offset; right plant has distinct branched ochre root, single green stem with alternate elongated leaves radiating at top. Small reddish curling form near base of right plant, unclear if root or separate element.

Inflorescence is a textured spike/spathe-like structure with red rounded spots atop a single tall stem; large curling lobed leaves in green/blue; fibrous roots uncolored. Green bleed staining visible left side.
Large pale blue-green wash bleed/offset visible mid-page; buds along stem are green, closed; single terminal flower shows blue pigment; roots are horizontal and spiky.
Upper stem bears a raceme-like spike of small oval blue structures with dark striations; lower leaves broad-lanceolate; mild staining lower-right and gutter.
Large green paint offset/bleed on left half of page. Upper stem bears a curved elongated pod-like structure with small round globes; faded script notes in lower left margin.
Root system is strongly sinuous/horizontal with multiple finger-like terminations in red. Faint blue wash/offset visible in mid-left background. Flowers appear as rounded compound heads.
Primary plant has dense rounded blue flower-head with radiating fine stems; mass of green serrated leaves with ochre/brown base. Secondary faint plant at left. Dark blots on two leaves.
Plant emerges from a sketchy green vessel/pot at base. Blue pigment visible in small clustered florets at branch tips; yellow dots at flower centres. Light blue staining on lower page.
Leaves have strongly pointed, star-like lobed tips. Large bell-shaped flowers with dark blue petals. Significant blue-green offset/bleed stain on left half of page.

Root emerges from a shallow vessel bearing two small drawn face profiles at sides. Flower heads radiate green petals around a spotted central disc. Bulbous calyx-like structures below flower heads. Some blue-green staining on left margin.

Three small circular ochre structures at base of roots; two large composite flower-heads with concentric layered petals. Pale blue wash stain lower-left. Lobed leaves are deeply fingered/stellate in form.
Root mass is large, fleshy, spreading laterally with red/ochre pigment. Flowerheads globose with spiny green bracts and blue interior. Multiple branching stems at apex.
Root rendered as a four-legged animal form. Pairs of round fruits (green/brown) hang from horizontal branches. Cone-like inflorescences at branch tips. Blueish stain upper-centre.
Primary plant: large cup-shaped ochre body with green fringe top; red stem; blue curling petals/stamens atop red central structure. Secondary plant faint/offset left.
Blue stain/offset visible mid-left. Root system is wide, gnarled, and horizontal. Flower clusters show small blue roundels with red centers on some. Large lobed canopy at apex.
Leaves rendered in two tones: deep green and ochre/yellow; branched root system with thick curling arms; small blue cluster flowers at stem tips; offset bleed from facing folio visible lower-left.
Multiple whorled palmate leaf clusters along branched stem; small rounded uncolored flower/bud structures at nodes; blue-green wash behind plant; dark stain at root base.
Large green wash stains on left margin obscure background. Flowers appear as tight rounded clusters of small circular forms, red-dotted. Root is ochre, looping/stringy.
Large paired lobed leaves arranged oppositely along single stem; terminal branch bears blue ovoid structures with small red-tipped florets. Collar-like ring at stem base.
Large spiky elongated leaf mass dominates upper page; small uncolored buds at lower stem; ochre stain near stem junction; numeric annotations visible on facing folio edge.
Dense alternating green/ochre broad leaves packed tightly; red streaks on stem; single blue radiating flower-head at apex; damage/hole mid-stem area.

Plant grows from a wide oval vessel/platform with many curved red leg-like appendages beneath. Multiple upright stems bear spotted, lanceolate leaves; single taller stem supports a blue bud/bloom with yellow/ochre florets at apex.
Leaves broad-oval, green with small white oval spots/markings. Two terminal flower clusters, each corymb-like; florets have blue petals and white centers. Roots spread widely, reddish-ochre.
Prominent round flower head with radiating blue petals and white centre; swollen ovoid calyx below flower; some light brown staining upper-right; blue-green tint in background.
Large domed inflorescence atop red tubular calyx on central plant; two smaller flanking plants share bulbous root clusters with pendant lobes. Small ink spots lower left.
Leaves are fan-shaped/lobed with frilled/crenate margins and small curled appendages around edges; blue wash stain visible mid-page. Root is thick and branched.
Dense umbel-like inflorescence of small blue-tipped florets on radiating white stalks; 2–3 swollen, elongated reddish-brown tuberous roots merge at base.
Large green ovate leaf with white midrib dominates upper right; small cluster of lobed red structures mid-right; blue-green stain/offset visible left margin.
Large spiky star-shaped terminal flower/bud; green bleed stain upper left affects page. Roots spread broadly from single stem base.
Multiple upright stems rise from a shared mound base; leaves form a dense continuous band; ~6 radiate flowerheads with yellow centres; roots are dense, fibrous, reddish-ochre.

Primary plant has large curling lobed leaves and branched stems bearing small blue-dotted flower clusters. Secondary plant (left) has narrower alternate leaves and a coiled zoomorphic animal form (snake-like) at its base instead of a root.
Large blue-green fan-shaped leaf rosette atop single tall red-tinged stem; fibrous root splays widely; blue pigment heavy on leaf interiors. Pale stain mid-page.
Large blue-green wash patch upper-left may be a faded secondary plant or offset/stain; flower appears as a striped bulbous structure on a slender red stalk.
Greenish stain upper-left area of page. Root is large, fleshy, tuberous with curling lobes; multiple stems rise from it. Terminal clusters resemble small compound sprays, coloured blue.
Large tuberous/rhizomatous root mass with ochre horizontal root bearing red-rimmed nodules along its length; two main erect stems rising from root; significant blue-green wash staining mid-page.
Three upright stems rise from a shared broad ochre/green mound-like base; numerous large lobed-tip leaves sweep laterally; small green stain near base.
Root has red accent marks at crown; flowers show layered disk-and-bract structure with blue outer bracts and ochre/yellow centres; blue-green water stain mid-page.

Two plants depicted: upper has lobed rosette on thin stem, no visible root; lower has large lobed mass on short stem with small red-brown bulbous root and fine fibrous tendrils. Blue-grey offset staining visible mid-page.
Three blue 5-petalled flowers atop slender branching stems; large ovate leaves in pairs; broad branched root with ochre/brown pigment; pale blue wash blob upper-left; minor staining mid-page.
Flowers at apex appear as circular disc heads with fringe; foliage units are bulbous-green with radiating points; blue-green wash staining visible mid-page.
Multiple branching stems rise from shared fibrous root; large deeply lobed green leaves dominate; terminal flowers have blue cup with pale ochre interior, ~4 visible.
Two large rounded lobed leaf-masses dominate upper area; tendrils bear small red bud-like structures along right margin; root is broad lobate ochre mass.
Large spiralling/curling lobed leaves dominate upper page; small blue star-like floret top-right; bulbous root drawn in ink only with curling tendrils; green wash stain left margin.

Large radiate flower head with two rings of blue-tipped petals and pale yellow/ochre central disc. Leaves lobed with serrated margins and blue interior markings. Multiple long stringy roots spread wide. Possible damp stain lower-centre.
Inflorescence is a dense, domed blue head with curled/hooked fringe tips; root mass is bulky with wavy serrated ridges and trailing branched extensions; faint green stain offset visible mid-left.
Leaves are large, lobed, heavily outlined in green with serrated/frilled margins and a pale central stripe. Root is forked and intertwined. Green pigment offset visible left margin.

Large sinuous/curling leaves wrap dramatically around a single upright stem; terminal and lateral branches bear clusters of small blue rounded bodies. Significant green pigment offset/bleed on left half of page.
Primary plant has a bulbous-lobed red/brown root with cross-bar appendages; ghost offset of a second plant visible on left. Flowers small, blue, at stem apex.
Large globular spiny/rayed flower-heads rendered entirely in green; blue-wash offset/stain visible in lower-left quadrant; root splays into several finger-like branches in ochre.

Root zone shows complex interlocking ochre/brown angular forms suggesting a stylised root-knot structure. Bleed-through from verso visible at left. Leaves show dense serrated margins with brown-green pigment variation. Flowers borne on curling tendrilled branches; large composite-form flower at upper left with white petals and red-lined sepal zone; smaller disc-form flowers on wiry lateral tendrils with red detailing. Page folio number "53" visible upper right.
Blue-green staining mid-page likely from pigment bleed. Two composite-like flower heads: outer ray-like petals red, central disc uncolored with dots; receptacle/collar blue.

Blue-green wash staining visible left of stem. Two bulbous, scale-patterned flower heads at top with small red-tipped petals emerging. Basal leaves extend below text block, serrated and bristle-edged.
Root is multi-lobed bulbous, dark red/brown. Upper stem branches into two curving raceme-like arms bearing round blue berry-like nodes. Light blue-green wash stains on left margin.
Plant emerges from a rounded vessel/pot. Three stems each terminate in a large red bulbous structure topped by a white-and-blue spherical flower head.
Large serrated leaves radiate broadly from a single ochre/brown stem; terminal inflorescence has small square/cube-shaped florets in blue-green. Some water staining mid-page.
Large circular flower head with radiating blue petals and central spiral; two spiny globular buds (green/blue); blue-washed stain behind text; basal root-like lobes uncolored.
Upper-right shows a small rounded form with blue spike-like projections and an uncolored curling frond; possible offset/bleed visible at left margin as faint starburst impression.
Prominent rounded bulb at base with fibrous ochre roots radiating outward; multiple small blue flowers at branch tips; deeply lobed green leaves throughout.
Central rosette/floral motif surrounded by ~4 human-bust figures; pale blue-green wash in inner zone; star-like glyphs in lower margin area.
Three small star-burst glyphs with radiating pointed rays drawn in left margin alongside text blocks; page number '58' top right in different hand.
Small eight-pointed star drawn in upper margin in ochre/brown; green pigment visible at right edge, likely from adjacent folio bleed-through.
Root system shows multiple pendant tubers on spreading runners. Star-shaped flower heads at branch tips; blue smudging upper right may be pigment bleed. Small marginal inscription lower left.
Light blue wash behind plant; single blue flower at apex; numerous small rounded flower heads with fringed/rayed edges on branching stems; some foxing/staining visible.
Small ink-only figure in lower-left margin: reclining human-like form near cylindrical and circular shapes. Staining along lower gutter. Text dominates page.
Large dome-shaped striated top structure with green/white horizontal banding; small blue buds at branch tips; faint pencil-sketch figures near lower left margin.
Central disc bears a drawn face; alternating red and blue pointed rays radiate outward; small star glyphs scattered in outer ring sectors.
Central disc shows a face; inner ring has alternating red/blue radiating pointed segments; outer rings carry crescent/phase motifs. Brown stain visible mid-diagram.

Right page: radial diagram with face+rays at centre, surrounded by two rings of star glyphs (ochre/green) and text. Left page: scattered small figures, floral medallion (green), partial coloured disc (red/blue/green).

Right page: radial diagram with face+rays at centre, radiating spokes, star glyphs in ochre/green fill two rings; left page: scattered small figures with small circular/cross motifs and a quartered circle in green/blue/red.
Three sub-sections visible: left has radial-ray face + freeform stars; centre has crescent-face + blue-ringed face; right is circular medallion with sun-face centre and ring of stars.
Three panels visible: left has radial-spoke sun-face + moon-face medallion; centre has moon-face + blue-ringed face; right has large concentric-ring diagram with sun-face centre.

Three panels visible: left has freeform star-field with face-bearing disk; centre has moon-crescent face and second face-disk with blue ring; right has large concentric-ring diagram with central sun-face and star-filled band.
Three distinct circular diagrams on one opening: left has lobed outer ring with blue speckles; centre and right have radial-spoke rosettes with blue-filled petals and scattered star glyphs.

Three distinct circular diagrams on bifolio: left has lobed outer ring with blue spatter; centre and right have radial-spoke rosettes with blue-filled petals and ochre star glyphs scattered in outer ring.

Three distinct circular diagrams on a two-page spread. Left: large rosette ring with blue-speckled interior, star glyphs in outer ring. Centre and right: radial-spoke diagrams with blue-filled petal/sector forms and ochre star glyphs scattered in outer band. Some lower-left corner staining/damage.
Outer ring formed by oval/lobe segments, each tipped blue or green. Spokes radiate from small central star-rosette; alternating blue/green stripe pairs.
Three discrete circular diagrams on spread: left has radial blue/green club-shaped spokes; centre is petal/lobe rosette; right has a sun-face centre with large pointed rays.
Three distinct circular diagrams visible on spread: left has radial club-shaped elements in blue/green; centre has lobed rosette form; right has star-points with face motif at centre.
Spread shows 3 diagrams: left has radial blue/green elongated forms; centre is petal/lobed rosette; right has star-pointed form with face at centre.
Two tiles: left tile has recumbent elongated animal at centre; right tile has quadruped at centre. Figures in tubs/barrels in outer ring. Some blue pigment on figures' head coverings.
Central quadruped figure; outer ring figures alternate between standing in tubs/barrels and holding multi-pointed star glyphs; page number '71' in Arabic numerals top-right.
Foldout spread shows four concentric-ring diagrams; central creatures vary across panels (quadruped, human-figure); wax seal visible on second panel; fading and offset throughout.
Foldout spread shows 4 concentric-ring diagrams; central motifs vary per panel (quadruped, human-figure). Wax seal visible on second panel. Fading and foxing throughout.
Foldout spread shows four concentric-ring diagrams; a wax seal obscures part of panel 2; central figures vary across panels.
Foldout spread shows 4 concentric-ring diagrams; each has a distinct central creature or figure; wax seal visible on one panel; foxing/staining throughout.

Three diagrams across foldout: two on left leaf, one on right. Central motif on right diagram is a suspended balance-vessel with blue accent. Hole damage visible on right diagram; brown staining on left leaf binding edge.

Foldout spans two leaves (three scans). Three concentric rings populated with standing human figures interspersed with multi-pointed star glyphs. Central emblem on rightmost panel shows a suspended balance-like vessel with blue accent; central emblem on left panels shows a blue-accented standing figure. Small red dot accent visible near left-panel centre. Hole damage visible in right panel scan.
Foldout spread shows three separate concentric-ring diagrams across two tiles; rightmost has blue-pigmented central figure; hole damage visible in second tile.
Central quadruped figure painted green; multi-pointed star glyph immediately above it; outer ring populated with standing human figures alternating with star glyphs.
Central figure clothed in blue, holding implement; outer ring has unclothed standing figures interspersed with star glyphs; green stain lower-left quadrant.

Upper scene: large green elongated vessel/basin with multiple busts in a row; labelled tablets above. Lower scene: smaller blue-tinted basin with clustered figures. Sinuous tube extends from upper vessel toward page top and bottom margin. Some blue radiating lines from central upper structure suggest spray or emanation. Small blue circle near page top-right.
Folio number '76' visible upper right. Decorative tall initial at top-left. Minor discoloration/staining at lower corners. No pictorial illustration present.
Figures distributed along left margin at multiple vertical levels; lower figure appears to emerge from or stand within a scalloped/layered rounded form; small red suspended vessel visible mid-page.

Top register: arched green channel with pendant spouts and small oval/circular blue-red nodes; two standing figures at margins holding or supporting structure. Middle-left: figure reclining in or beside a large curved vessel with coiled tube. Lower-left: standing figure holds a blue sphere beside a tall scaly/feathered cylindrical form. Illustrations are scattered in left margin and top band amid dense text blocks.

Top register: 3 standing figures linked by curved tube/channel with central blue-filled basin. Left/right margins: smaller basins with seated or reclining figures. One figure wears crown-like headdress.
Two large oval pools filled with green liquid and reclining figures; connected by a narrow blue channel; elaborate tube-and-cylinder apparatus at top margin with small fan-like structures.

Single large elongated basin filled with green liquid; a thin curving tube rises from left side toward upper margin. Blue arched niches decorate basin exterior. ~9-10 figures visible seated/standing in vessel. Faint staining on page.
Figures distributed along left margin in vertical sequence; lower basin filled with green pigment; blue pigment in upper vessel/tube; possible liquid-flow stain at bottom.
Upper figure stands in/on tiered basin with blue fill; a tube descends left margin linking to lower basin; bottom scene shows green mound with small quadruped animals.

Top register: row of small standing figures above text block. Mid-page: large blue-green liquid-filled basin with reclining/in-vessel figures; right-margin tube/spout. Lower left: smaller vessel with figure. Lower right: tall stemmed cup form with figure and tube.
Figures distributed in left/right margins and bottom; large elongated blue-green trough/channel at foot of page holds reclining figures. Small pedestal basins mid-left margin.
Upper basin is oval/flat with green fill; lower basin is rounded/lobed atop a cylindrical pedestal. A thin tube runs along left margin connecting both basins.
Large rounded-rectangular tub, two rows of figures immersed to waist in green fill; a long green tube/spout exits upper-left corner toward margin. Small marginal text label visible lower-left.

Three distinct illustration zones: top has standing figures flanking tiered vessel; mid has reclining figure in green-filled tub; bottom has large green lobed pool with multiple figures emerging or standing within/around it.

Top band: figures reclining on arc/cloud forms with tubes; mid-left: figure in circular green-outlined vessel; bottom: figures amid large green mound with nested arc forms. Some bleed-through visible.
Left margin: stacked small figures and a tub with red band. Lower centre: arched blue tube connecting two basins with a figure seated within; spiky radial form in blue-green below.

Upper cluster: two large green rounded lobed forms connected by a ridged/hatched joint; small figures stand at/in tub-like vessels at left and upper-left. Lower-right: single figure seated/reclining wrapped in a green curving tube-like form with blue element near torso.
Three distinct illustration zones interrupt text blocks: top scalloped-canopy basin, mid oval vessel, lower-left cluster with blue liquid; blue tube runs down left margin.
Two roughly circular basins stacked vertically on right margin, connected by a sinuous tube/channel; upper basin smaller; multiple small figures crowd interiors.

Two circular diagrams visible on foldout: left has crosshatch/spoke form with small figures and a central face-like disc; right has concentric scalloped rings with a crescent-and-disc centre. Blue pigment present on both. Right page is text-only. Some offset/browning noted.
Central disk bears crescent/partial-disc motif in ochre; outer rings densely filled with scale/leaf-like texture with blue dot accents; rightmost panel text-only.

Multi-panel foldout; ~6 discrete circular diagrams visible. Central large diagram contains standing human figures in innermost ring. Radial star-burst motifs with blue/ochre petals appear in two panels. Fold crease damage obscures some detail.

Left diagram: radial-spoke rosette with blue-filled central disc bearing a face; small human figure at top. Right diagram: dense concentric rings with scaled/feathered texture; crescent+face centre. Faint offset staining visible.

Left folio: circular diagram with radiating spokes, small human figures, and a central face-like form in blue. Centre: concentric ringed diagram with scalloped/scaled banding and a crescent-like central form, blue dot accents. Right folio: several fragmentary forms with scalloped/scaled textures, faint linear sketches, and rounded lobed outlines; possible ink offset visible.

Two circular diagrams: left has radiating arms with concave lobes and small human figures; right has dense concentric scalloped bands with crescent at centre. Right folio bears several small freehand sketches (biological-looking segmented/lobed forms) interspersed with text blocks. Faint page number '86' visible upper-left of lower scan; '129' lower-right. Some ink offset and toning across gutter.

Left diagram: radial-spoke layout with central sun-faced disc and small human figures at cardinal spoke ends; right diagram: concentric scalloped/scaled ring bands, crescent+face at centre; scattered blue dots in outer ring. Second scan tile shows freeform biomorphic outlines, likely a separate folio section.
Root has bulbous central body with multiple spreading red-brown tendrils. Two leafy whorls on stem; inflorescences at stem tips show small blue-tipped clusters. Green offset wash visible mid-page.

Two plants share large intertwined tuberous roots. Right plant has branched inflorescence with many small red-tipped florets; left plant has a single small round flower. Marginal script in left gutter.
Three-page spread; numerous detached plant fragments interleaved with vessels. Some roots bear elongated zoomorphic or limb-like protrusions. Offset and mild foxing present.
Three-page spread; numerous vessels range from tall banded cylindrical jars to footed/pedestal forms. Root fragments show limb-like branching. Staining affects lower left gutter.
Three folio panels; numerous detached plant fragments interspersed with vessels. Some root forms are elongated and sinuous, possibly zoomorphic. Staining visible on right panel.
Large blue bulbous seed/fruit forms on centre page; red ribbon/bow form mid-left; heavy green offset/staining upper page; footed vessel right holds branching stems with round blue-green nodes.
